statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let d := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ‖S n (fun k => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) t - S n (high n) t‖; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, m (B n) (fun t => (d n t)^2) ≤ ε*(n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 素数幂与低端素数的换权误差在共振区上为 o(n)
plain_statement.en: The masked squared cost of the full Mangoldt substitution is o(n)

brief.zh: 逐点误差平方至多 16n log² n，乘以带对数权趋零的掩码面积。结论关于谱差的平方，尚需处理与主谱的交叉项。
brief.en: Square the uniform error and use masked-area decay after two logarithmic powers. The estimate concerns the squared difference; the eventual energy transfer also controls the mixed term.
